meta.confirmedRule: confirmed:true only where the figure was read on the publisher's own page or document (HTML, PDF or data file fetched directly). A search-engine summary of a page that could not be fetched, or a secondary report of a publisher's figure, is confirmed:false.
meta.derivedRule: derived:true marks a figure computed here from confirmed inputs; the inputs and arithmetic are given in 'method'.
meta.nullRule: null means not found; the note says what was looked for.

waits.city: London (national figure; London not separated here)
waits.measure: Referral-to-treatment (RTT), consultant-led elective care, patients still waiting at month end
waits.note: RTT clock starts at referral and stops at first definitive treatment, so it is referral-to-treatment, not referral-to-first-appointment. Figures include NHS England's estimates for three non-reporting trusts and Cora Health MSK.
waits.source: NHS England, Statistical Press Notice: NHS referral to treatment (RTT) waiting times data, July 2026

waits.measure: Outpatient waiting list (waiting for a first hospital outpatient consultation)
waits.note: NTPF's May 2026 release gives the total only; the time-band distribution is in NTPF's open-data CSVs (by hospital and specialty), not read here.
waits.source: NTPF, NTPF Publishes May 2026 National Public Hospital Waiting List Data

waits.measure: Outpatient waiting list, later month, with long-wait bands
waits.note: From a search-engine summary; the Department of Health monthly release (gov.ie) returned 403 to the fetcher. The full band distribution (0-3, 3-6, 6-9, 9-12, 12-18, 18+ months) is in NTPF open data.
waits.source: Search summary attributed to NTPF/Department of Health monthly waiting list figures

waits.measure: Median wait, GP referral to specialist consultation, weighted median

waits.city: 15-metro average (includes New York and Los Angeles)
waits.measure: Average days to the first available new-patient appointment (secret-shopper calls to 1,391 offices)
waits.note: The press release does not give New York or Los Angeles city averages; they are in the full AMN report PDF, not read here. 'Obstetrics/gynecology 42 days' is the release's rounding of 41.8.

waits.measure: IMSS wait for a specialty consultation (diferimiento)
waits.note: No published IMSS average or median wait for a first specialty consultation was found. IMSS reported 29 million specialty consultations in 2025 (+22% on 2024) and day reductions for some surgeries (cataract -12 days, gallbladder -10 days), and 21,968 complaints about getting a specialty appointment in Q1 2025, all via press coverage, not an IMSS page.

costs.item: Medicare physician fee schedule, CPT 99204 (new patient office visit, moderate complexity, 45 min), non-facility
costs.method: Non-facility total RVU 5.31 (work 2.60, PE 2.47, MP 0.24) x conversion factor 33.4009 (non-QP) = 177.36
costs.note: Medicare pays 80% of this; private insurers typically pay more. The office/outpatient consultation codes 99243-99245 are status I (not payable by Medicare) but used by many private plans.
costs.source: CMS, PFS Relative Value Files RVU26D (PPRRVU2026_Oct_nonQPP)

costs.item: FAIR Health median allowed amount, CPT 99204, office setting
costs.note: From a search summary of a FAIR Health white paper; not opened. New York and Los Angeles commercial prices are available only through the FAIR Health Consumer lookup tool.
costs.source: FAIR Health, FH Healthcare Indicators and FH Medical Price Index 2025 (white paper)

costs.item: NHS specialist (consultant) outpatient appointment after GP referral
costs.note: Free at point of use for ordinarily resident patients. The cost is the wait (see referrals.waits).
costs.source: Spire Healthcare, Costs and prices ('NHS patients: The NHS covers all consultation and treatment costs')

costs.note: Consultants set their own fees. Spire Claremont's guide prices list initial consultations from about £150-£225 (search summary, not opened).

costs.item: Average private consultation price across 15 specialties
costs.note: Practice Plus Group's own consultation is £145; Circle Health from £200. London not separated.

costs.item: Public hospital outpatient consultation after GP referral
costs.note: No charge for public outpatient services for those ordinarily resident; not re-read from HSE/Citizens Information this session (citizensinformation.ie returned 403).
The listed doctor's consultant status is not stated on the page.

costs.item: Typical private consultant initial consultation range
costs.note: Search summary of a practice-management blog (AskBrigid) and others; the two clinic price lists above (EUR 200) sit inside it. A 2026 Irish Times letter cites a EUR 400 first consultation. Insurer outpatient refunds per visit are small (search summary: VHI EUR 60, Laya EUR 40, Irish Life EUR 50-60 on entry plans).

costs.item: Insured specialist consultation (OHIP) after GP referral
costs.note: Billed to OHIP; no patient charge. A specialist consultation needs a referral to bill the consult code.

costs.item: OMA suggested uninsured fee, internal medicine consultation (A135) — what an uninsured patient could be charged
costs.method: OMA fee = 2.9 x OHIP fee (2026 multiplier), based on the 3 March 2025 OHIP Schedule of Benefits
costs.note: Code-to-specialty labels (A13x internal medicine, A60x cardiology, A41x gastroenterology) are from general OHIP knowledge, not read on the page. Physicians may charge less.
costs.source: Ontario Medical Association, The 2026 Schedule of Fees (suggested uninsured)

costs.note: Insured visits are free under MSP. The Doctors of BC uninsured fee guide (1 Apr 2024) was read: its $342 'Specialist' line (A94526) is an hourly court/expert-witness rate, not a consultation fee, though a search summary presented it as one. No uninsured consultation fee found.
costs.source: Doctors of BC, Revised Fees for Uninsured Services, effective April 1, 2024

costs.item: Private specialist consultation, sample CDMX prices
costs.note: Doktor.mx labels these 'rangos estimados del sector privado' (estimated ranges), so treat as a platform estimate, not a price survey.

costs.item: IMSS specialist consultation for insured workers (derechohabientes)
costs.note: No charge to affiliates; access is by referral from the Unidad de Medicina Familiar. Not re-read from an IMSS page this session.

referralShare.measure: Share of all office visits (all physician specialties) with disposition 'Refer to other physician'
referralShare.note: NAMCS covers all office-based physicians, not only primary care; more than one disposition may be recorded per visit. Earlier tables: 9.0% (2010), 7.6% (2014), 8.3% (2015), 8.1% (2016) per search summary.
referralShare.source: CDC/NCHS, National Ambulatory Medical Care Survey: 2019 National Summary Tables, Table 25

referralShare.measure: Share of GP appointments that resulted in a referral
referralShare.note: IfG's analysis of NHS Digital 'Appointments in general practice, July 2022'. Referral here is to any service, not only consultant outpatients.
referralShare.source: Institute for Government, Performance Tracker 2022/23: General practice

referralShare.measure: GP consultations resulting in a referral to secondary care
referralShare.method: 9.3 million GP referrals (HES 2008) against GP consultations (62% of 300 million practice consultations); the report rounds to 'one in twenty'
referralShare.source: The King's Fund, The quality of GP diagnosis and referral (2010)

referralShare.measure: Share of GP visits ending in a specialist referral
referralShare.note: No published national or provincial figure found.

sleep.guidance2016: Under 18 months: avoid screens other than video-chatting; 2-5 years: limit to 1 hour/day of high-quality programming, co-viewed

sleep.note: 2016 limits from search summaries of AAP 'Media and Young Minds' (Pediatrics 2016;138(5):e20162591), not read on aap.org. The 2025/26 shift is as reported by EdSurge (5 Feb 2026), read directly.

worthChecking: LAUSD daily instructional minutes come from a June 2023 bulletin written for 183-day years; the 2026-27 calendar has 180 days, so minutes may have been raised.
NYC 177 student days is Chalkbeat's count; the DOE calendar page lists only dates.
TDSB's 187 instructional days is a search figure (194-day Ontario year less 7 PA days); TDSB's page listed 8 PA-day dates mixing elementary/secondary.
Ireland's Sept 2026 €183.70 is described as the 'highest possible upfront cost'; it matches a net-of-universal-subsidy figure (2025: €198.70), so the gross cap is likely €280, not €183.70.
Mexico SEP secundaria matutino 7:30-12:30 conflicts with a 7-hour daily minimum; check SEP's lineamientos for secundaria.
Ireland primary hours are under review (Irish Times, Aug 2026); Circular 11/95's 5h40m may change.

Child Care Aware NY dollar figures are images in the PDF and come from a search summary; the 2025 report may publish newer numbers (search snippet suggested CA $21,945 and CT $20,254 for infant centre care in a '2025' framing, which do not match the 2024 sheets read here).
OMA uninsured codes: confirm which OHIP code is the specialist consultation for each specialty before using a specific code.
Medicare 99204 locality amounts assume the work GPCI shown already includes the 1.0 floor; 2026 GPCIs read from GPCI2026.csv in RVU26D.
AAP 2016 screen-time limits not read on aap.org; the 2025 policy statement itself not read.
